contract.question: Can the existing EMC tissue cohorts support an independently validated therapeutic-address atlas with compatible normal-tissue contrasts, and exactly which claim is identifiable from the available evidence?
contract.stop_condition: Deliver a source-keyed feasibility matrix and concise decision memo identifying defensible contrasts or a decisive failed gate. Reuse completed readiness and sensitivity outputs; no new expression estimates or target ranking.

clinical_relevance.basis: Inherits first-ranked EMC therapeutic-address atlas; informs experimental tissue target validation.

answerability.basis: Existing cohort and normal-tissue artifacts can establish identifiable contrasts or an explicit missing-evidence gate.

validation.basis: Source pointers, sample/assay identifiers and finite counts can be independently checked.

information_gain.basis: Adds normal-tissue compatibility and independent contrast decisions beyond completed CHRNA6 cache readiness; no repeat of that audit.

contract.instructions: Read the ranked recommendation and reuse both completed audits. Focus specifically on independent EMC tissue validation and normal-tissue compatibility, not CHRNA6 probe retrieval. Audit GSE28866 normal-organ libraries and EMC samples against GSE24369/GSE4303 and fourth-cohort metadata. Establish the unit of observation (run/library/specimen/patient), identifiers, known versus unresolved overlap, assay/reference channel, normalization and available per-sample versus aggregate values. Treat GSE24369 as CHRNA6 discovery cohort, not independent validation; explain scope. For each proposed within-cohort and cross-cohort contrast, report defensible/conditional/unidentified with exact reasons. Separate cross-histology specificity from tumour-versus-normal and RNA from surface protein; PRAME is an intracellular HLA-presented address. Normal bulk tissues cannot establish therapeutic window. Do not normalize or pool incompatible technologies, infer independence from different accessions, or turn missing cache data into absent expression. Include exact JSON pointers and source file/value SHA256s for extracted facts; explicitly label coordinator-supplied premises versus computed/source-supported facts. Build a deterministic small script generating JSON and a concise memo with valid YAML metadata (kind memo, audience maintainers/autonomous research agents, purpose, scope, date, last_verified). Rerun for byte-identical output; checks must cover identifiers/counts and unknowns, not prose constants. If existing inputs cannot establish independent cohorts or compatible normal-tissue comparisons, deliver that precise negative, list the smallest missing primary evidence, and stop. If feasible, name one concrete prespecified comparison and its limitations without executing it. No network, installs, paid compute, figures, target ranking, biomarker estimates, p-values, survival/clinical claims, manuscript/registry changes, broad literature search, or new process framework. No subagents. Medium, one dispatch,1800seconds. Use runner-supplied Python. Do not redo completed sensitivity/readiness arithmetic except checking relevant input values. Explicit user-authorized retry after reconciled run 20260905T121951Z-b093a5d8bc failed on repeated websocket idle timeouts with no deliverables. Read its verification.json as operational history, not scientific evidence. Do not reproduce the long orientation: inspect relevant source schemas selectively and write an initial concise feasibility memo early, then complete the deterministic source-keyed outputs within the same 1800-second limit. Save partial work promptly so another transport failure does not erase progress. Scientific question, evidence standards and stop condition are unchanged; retry authority is the user request to start it up again.
